ac-r01-resolvent-hilbert-identity.scientific_source: Wikipedia, Resolvent formalism, Resolvent identity; Dunford–Schwartz, Linear Operators I, Lemma 6 p. 568; Kato, Perturbation Theory for Linear Operators, 2nd ed. 1980; Fredholm, Acta Math. 27 (1903).

assumption_contract.notes: z,w in rho(A) DECLARED (invertibility of A-zI and A-wI). Holomorphy of R off the spectrum DECLARED. Newton/Hermite z->w limit DERIVED from that holomorphy. Convention (A-zI)^{-1} vs (zI-A)^{-1} is a branch choice, not a domain gap. No thermal folklore.

ac-r01-resolvent-hilbert-identity.source_expressions: Convention (Wikipedia): R(z, A) = (A - z*I)**(-1). Identity on the resolvent set: R(z, A) - R(w, A) - (z - w)*R(z, A)*R(w, A) = 0. Newton quotient: (R(z, A) - R(w, A))/(z - w) = R(z, A)*R(w, A). Scalar check (A -> a): ((1/(a - z) - 1/(a - w))/(z - w) - 1/((a - z)*(a - w))). Confluent node: diff(R(z, A), z) = R(z, A)**2.
